question: Among the customers who paid in euro, how many of them have a monthly consumption of over 1000?
actual_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT y.customer_id) AS euro_customers_with_monthly_consumption_over_1000
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c
  ON c.customer_id = y.customer_id
WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.consumption > 1000;
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T2.currency = 'EUR' AND T1.consumption > 1000.00
